q: Which segment has the highest expected revenue per customer?

WITH __segments AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    segment_name,
    customers,
    expected_revenue
  FROM customer_segmentation.analyst.segments
), rev_per_cust AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    segment_name,
    expected_revenue,
    customers,
    expected_revenue / NULLIF(NULLIF(customers, 0), 0) AS revenue_per_customer
  FROM __segments
)
SELECT
  segment,
  segment_name,
  expected_revenue,
  customers,
  revenue_per_customer
FROM rev_per_cust
QUALIFY
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_per_customer DESC NULLS LAST) = 1

WITH __segments AS (
  SELECT
    behavior_segment AS buying_style,
    behavior_name AS buying_style_name,
    customers,
    expected_revenue
  FROM customer_segmentation.analyst.segments
), buying_style_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    buying_style,
    buying_style_name,
    SUM(expected_revenue) AS total_expected_revenue,
    SUM(customers) AS total_customers
  FROM __segments
  GROUP BY
    buying_style,
    buying_style_name
  QUALIFY
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_expected_revenue DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
  buying_style,
  buying_style_name,
  total_expected_revenue,
  total_customers
FROM buying_style_revenue
